title: Key control classification
prompt:
This check applies only to non-key controls (key_control = No). Determine whether the control should instead be classified as a Key Control based on risk heat, risk description, and control design.

Assess how well the current non-key classification fits as: Strong (appropriately non-key), Partial, or Weak (likely should be key).

Return alignment, alignment_rationale (max 3 sentences), and proposed_solution (max 3 sentences).
